headline: Highest risk is medium data leakage/cascading error: Khoj reads indexed notes and can use broad network egress, while ai-engineering-hub is docs-only and its interaction surface is unclear.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared channel is documented, but Khoj reads indexed files and notes while ai-engineering-hub is an open-source agent/RAG repository that could be used to generate content later copied into Khoj. The pathway is indirect and not default-documented, so low is the highest supportable severity.
conditions: IF outputs from ai-engineering-hub are manually pasted into Khoj chat or notes
IF a shared filesystem or export/import bridge is added between the two agents
mitigations: Keep the agents on separate workspaces
Disable copy-paste of untrusted agent output into Khoj prompts
Label imported text as untrusted in the operator workflow
Use a review step before any prompt ingestion
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging for imported content

B_data_leakage.rationale: Khoj touches personal notes and indexed documents and has broad network egress, so if it uploads retrieved content to a cloud backend or search provider, sensitive data can leave the local workspace. ai-engineering-hub is docs-only and its runtime data flow is not evidenced, so the pairwise leakage risk is inferred and medium rather than high.
conditions: IF Khoj is configured to use cloud inference or external search providers for indexed notes
IF ai-engineering-hub is used to generate prompts containing sensitive note excerpts
mitigations: Use self-hosted inference only
Restrict Khoj to local search providers
Exclude sensitive folders from indexing
Review outbound network destinations before enabling sync
requires-engineering: enforce per-document redaction before retrieval

C_capability_conflict.rationale: ai-engineering-hub has no documented write or shell capabilities, while Khoj cannot write files or modify git state. Overlap is mainly read-side and conversational, so direct resource contention is limited; the pair does not show a default write-write conflict.
conditions: IF ai-engineering-hub is deployed with additional write or git permissions not shown in the profile
IF both agents are pointed at the same mutable workspace through external orchestration
mitigations: Keep Khoj read-only against indexed sources
Do not grant ai-engineering-hub write or git permissions
Separate mutable repos from retrieval indexes
Run a quick permission audit before pairing
requires-engineering: add workspace locking if write access is later introduced

D_cascading_error.rationale: Khoj is a retrieval/chat system over personal notes and indexed documents, so if ai-engineering-hub-generated text is imported as source material, Khoj may surface or act on it without verification. The interaction is plausible but not directly documented, so medium is appropriate under uncertainty.
conditions: IF ai-engineering-hub output is ingested into Khoj as authoritative notes or documents
IF Khoj users rely on retrieved text without a human verification step
mitigations: Require human review before indexing generated content
Mark AI-generated notes with a distinct tag
Add a verification checklist for retrieved claims
Limit Khoj actions to read-only summarization
requires-engineering: add citation/traceability metadata to indexed items

E_compliance.rationale: Khoj explicitly touches personal notes and indexed documents, which can include regulated or sensitive data, while ai-engineering-hub is an open-source repository with no residency or retention controls documented. Because the pair lacks documented compliance alignment, the safest supported finding is a medium mismatch risk rather than a higher residency breach.
conditions: IF personal notes indexed by Khoj include regulated data classes
IF ai-engineering-hub is used in a workflow that stores or republishes those notes outside the user's policy boundary
mitigations: Avoid indexing regulated documents
Keep secrets out of prompts and notes
Review retention settings in Khoj
Use separate datasets for compliant and non-compliant content
requires-engineering: document residency and retention boundaries
